content.title: Olde Town Employee & Residential Parking Permits
content.summary: Employee parking permits for the Olde Town Transit Hub must be renewed every three months and allow for free parking without daily registration, with a limit of 300 permits issued. Residents of single-family homes on Yukon St. and Grant Pl. can apply for residential parking permits with proof of residency, while apartment residents in mixed-use properties must rely on their property owners for parking solutions and are not eligible for the permit program.
content.body:
For Employee and Residential Parking Permit questions, please [email the Parking Program](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#d8a8b9aab3b1b6bf98b9aaaeb9bcb9f6b7aabf).

- [Apply for an Employee or a Residential Parking Permit](https://arvada.cmrpay.com/dashboard/landing).

## Employee Parking Permits

- Permits need to be renewed every three months following the receipt of a reminder email.
- Employee parking permits are only valid for parking within the Olde Town Transit Hub parking structure.
- The employee parking permit exempts the vehicle from the posted timed restrictions within the public parking area of the Hub without having to register daily.
- Employee parking is free at this time.
- Permits will be issued in the order they are received with a maximum of 300 permits issued.

## Olde Town Residential Parking Permits

Residents who live in the **single-family homes on Yukon St. and Grant Pl.** may apply for a [residential parking permit](https://arvada.cmrpay.com/dashboard/landing) for Olde Town with proof of residency.

For apartment residents within Olde Town in mixed-use properties, the responsibility to have on-site parking falls on the property owner. If no on-site parking is available, the tenant is responsible for locating a viable, long-term parking option. These residents are not eligible for the residential permit program.
